answer: Sequential-work birth certificates: a new agent identity is valid only after it computes a verifiable delay function seeded by a fresh pearl of on-chain randomness, taking about seven days on one core that parallel hardware cannot shorten. Ten thousand sybils mean ten thousand machines idling a full week each, burning power like saffron burns money. The finished proof becomes a relic: cheap for anyone to verify, impossible to precompute or resell, since each seed is bound to its own key.
